checks.s: The NDA is structured as a mutual (bilateral) agreement under which each party is designated as both a Discloser and a Recipient throughout the operative provisions.
The defined terms 'Discloser,' 'Recipient,' and 'Confidential Information' consistently apply to both parties throughout the NDA.
The NDA identifies 'Verdana Holdings, Inc.' as a corporation organized under the laws of Delaware (or 'a Delaware corporation').
The NDA identifies 'Castellan Data Systems, LLC' as a limited liability company organized under the laws of Delaware (or 'a Delaware limited liability company').
The NDA includes Verdana's principal office address as 400 Ridgeview Plaza, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801.
The NDA includes Castellan's principal office address as 8550 Meridian Park Drive, 4th Floor, Reston, VA 20190.
The recitals describe the Transaction as the potential acquisition by Verdana of a 72% membership-interest stake in Castellan.
The recitals state the enterprise value ($385,000,000) or other financial terms (equity value, revenue, EBITDA, multiples).
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates financial statements and projections (or financial forecasts).
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates source code.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates algorithms.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates trade secrets.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates customer lists and/or supplier lists.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates employee data (or employee information/personnel data).
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates government-contract terms.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' references ITAR/EAR-controlled technical data.
The definition of 'Confidential Information' specifically enumerates deal-related communications (or deal communications, transaction-related correspondence, or substantially equivalent language).
The NDA includes an exclusion from Confidential Information for information that is or becomes publicly available through no fault of the Recipient.
The NDA includes an exclusion from Confidential Information for information already known to the Recipient without restriction prior to disclosure.
The NDA includes an exclusion from Confidential Information for information independently developed by the Recipient without use of the Discloser's Confidential Information.
The NDA includes an exclusion from Confidential Information for information received from a third party not under an obligation of confidentiality (or without breach).
The NDA specifies that confidentiality obligations survive for 3 years.
The 3-year confidentiality period is measured from the date of disclosure of each item of Confidential Information (not from the NDA effective date or termination of discussions).
The NDA includes a standstill provision.
The standstill period is 18 months from NDA execution.
The standstill provision restricts Verdana from acquiring Castellan securities or membership interests outside the negotiated Transaction.
The standstill provision requires Castellan board/member consent for any such acquisition by Verdana.
The NDA includes a non-solicitation of employees provision that is mutual (binding both parties).
The non-solicitation period is 24 months from NDA execution.
The non-solicitation provision is limited in scope to employees introduced or identified through the due-diligence process.
The NDA defines Permitted Disclosees (or Representatives) to include directors, officers, employees, and advisors.
The Permitted Disclosees definition requires that such persons have a need to know the Confidential Information.
The NDA requires each Permitted Disclosee to be bound by confidentiality obligations at least as protective (or no less restrictive) as those in the NDA.
The compelled-disclosure section permits disclosure required by law, regulation, or legal process.
The compelled-disclosure section requires prompt written notice to the Discloser where legally permitted.
The compelled-disclosure section requires cooperation to obtain a protective order or other appropriate remedy.
The NDA requires return or destruction of Confidential Information within 15 business days.
The 15-business-day return/destruction deadline is triggered by written request or termination of discussions.
The return/destruction provision requires an officer certification of destruction.
The return/destruction provision includes a carve-out permitting retention of archival or compliance copies held by legal counsel.
The NDA includes a specific anti-competitive-use covenant barring each Recipient from using the other party's Confidential Information for competitive purposes.
The anti-competitive-use covenant addresses use of the other party's Confidential Information for competitive purposes.
The anti-competitive-use covenant references or reflects the parties' overlapping predictive-analytics business or the competitive overlap.
The NDA includes a covenant against re-export of ITAR-controlled technical data.
The ITAR covenant references ITAR (22 CFR §§ 120–130).
The NDA includes a covenant against re-export of EAR-controlled technical data.
The EAR covenant references EAR (15 CFR §§ 730–774).
The NDA's ITAR/EAR provisions reflect or acknowledge that Castellan holds active U.S. Department of Defense contracts.
The NDA includes a 'no obligation to transact' disclaimer expressly providing that neither party is obligated to proceed with the Transaction or any other transaction by virtue of the NDA.
The remedies section acknowledges that a breach may cause irreparable harm (or irreparable injury) not adequately compensable by monetary damages.
The remedies section entitles the non-breaching party to seek injunctive relief.
The remedies section provides injunctive relief without the requirement of posting a bond or other security.
The remedies section preserves all other remedies available at law or equity (injunctive relief is in addition to, not in lieu of, other remedies).
The NDA includes a limitation-of-damages clause excluding liability for consequential, incidental, and punitive damages.
The limitation-of-damages clause includes an express carve-out restoring availability of excluded damage categories in cases of willful breach (or intentional/deliberate breach).
The NDA specifies governing law as the State of Delaware.
The governing-law clause applies Delaware law without regard to its conflicts-of-law principles (or choice-of-law rules).
The NDA designates the Delaware Court of Chancery as the primary forum.
The NDA provides that jurisdiction in the Delaware Court of Chancery is exclusive.
The NDA provides a fallback to the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware if the Court of Chancery declines jurisdiction.
The notices section designates Priya Narasimhan, SVP Corporate Development, at 400 Ridgeview Plaza, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801 as the Verdana contact for notices.
The notices section designates David Harlowe, General Counsel, at 8550 Meridian Park Drive, 4th Floor, Reston, VA 20190 as the Castellan contact for notices.
Annex A identifies 'Infolock VDR Services, Inc.' (or 'Infolock VDR Services') as the virtual data room provider.
Annex A includes the VDR Room ID 'PRP-2025-0714'.
Annex A specifies a cap of 8 clean-team members per side (or per party).
Annex A identifies source code as a category of restricted information.
Annex A identifies government-classified contract annexes as a category of restricted information.
Annex A includes a requirement for access logging of data-room materials.
Annex A includes a requirement for watermarking of data-room materials.
Annex A requires that clean-team members accessing ITAR/EAR-controlled materials be U.S. persons.
The signature block for Verdana Holdings, Inc. designates Priya Narasimhan with the title SVP, Corporate Development (or Senior Vice President, Corporate Development) as the authorized signatory.
The signature block for Castellan Data Systems, LLC designates David Harlowe with the title General Counsel as the authorized signatory.
The NDA references 'Project Parapet' as the project code name in the recitals or defined-term section.
The NDA includes a general provision requiring that amendments be in writing (signed by both parties).
The NDA includes a general provision stating that failure to exercise a right does not constitute a waiver (no implied waiver).
The NDA includes a severability provision (if any provision is held invalid, the remainder continues in effect).
The NDA includes an entire agreement (integration) clause.
The NDA includes a counterparts provision.
The counterparts provision recognizes electronic signatures.
The NDA body or annexes contain the enterprise value figure of $385,000,000 (or $385M or equivalent).
The NDA body or annexes contain the implied equity value of $277,200,000 (or $277.2M or equivalent).
The NDA body or annexes contain Castellan's revenue figure of $117,500,000 (or $117.5M or equivalent).
The NDA body or annexes contain Castellan's EBITDA figure of $31,400,000 (or $31.4M or equivalent).
The NDA body incorporates Annex A by reference and states that Annex A forms an integral part of the NDA (or uses substantially equivalent language such as 'attached hereto and incorporated herein').
The NDA states an effective date of July 14, 2025.
Annex A includes provisions addressing prohibited actions including downloading, printing, and taking screenshots.
Annex A includes a breach-notification timeline specifying a time period within which breaches of the protocol must be reported.
Annex A includes certification-of-compliance mechanics requiring clean-team members or their principals to certify compliance with the protocol.
The notices section includes a copy-to-counsel provision listing Marcus Adeyemi at Linden & Pace LLP, 51 West 52nd Street, 37th Floor, New York, NY 10019 for Verdana.
The notices section includes a copy-to-counsel provision listing Elena Tsai at Brevard Shaw & Koh LLP, 1401 K Street NW, Suite 800, Washington, DC 20005 for Castellan.
The defined term 'Transaction' describes the contemplated acquisition of a 72% membership-interest stake in Castellan Data Systems, LLC by Verdana Holdings, Inc.
The 'Transaction' definition includes specific financial terms (enterprise value, equity value, revenue, EBITDA, multiples).
The NDA body or Annex A contains bracketed placeholders, placeholder text (e.g., '[●]', '[Insert]', '[TBD]'), or unfilled fields.
The NDA includes within the scope of Confidential Information the existence of the Transaction, the fact that the parties are in discussions, and/or the terms under discussion.
